value.rationale: A complete geometric line census and full Fano scheme are natural exact invariants of a smooth K3 quartic. Five base-field lines do not preclude extra geometric lines over field extensions, so the proved absence of hidden lines changes the known geometric information in a precise and useful way. The split etale scheme determines all extension counts and Frobenius behavior. It does not pretend to settle the whole Picard lattice or all space-filling quartics.
